titre: Devoir de contrôle n°1 - Anglais (3ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Unemployment among young graduates has become a serious problem in many countries, including Tunisia. Every year, thousands of talented young people finish university, full of hope, only to find that there are no jobs waiting for them. This situation is discouraging and can lead to frustration and even depression. However, some young people refuse to give up. Instead of waiting for a job, they create their own. With a good idea, courage and a little support, they start small businesses that not only give them an income but also create jobs for others. Governments and banks should encourage this spirit by offering loans and training to young entrepreneurs. The future belongs to those who dare to take initiative.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What serious problem does the text deal with?   (2 marks)
2) What negative effects can unemployment have on young people?   (2 marks)
3) What do some young people do instead of waiting for a job?   (2 marks)
4) How can governments and banks help young entrepreneurs?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "should": Governments ______ encourage young entrepreneurs.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): The future belongs to those ______ dare to take initiative.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (instead of / because): ______ waiting for a job, they create their own.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "encourage" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"How can young people fight unemployment?" Write a paragraph (about 10 lines) proposing solutions (entrepreneurship, training, self-development…). Use "should / can" and linkers.
